agent_explanation: Body 0 starts just east of thin wall 0 (x=[5.5,5.7], distance 0.1) with high speed 55.6 and dt=0.0319. In one step it displaces ~1.06 west and ~1.43 south to x=5.24 west of wall, crossing straight through the wall interior between discrete positions. Despite 60 substeps, there is no continuous collision detection for thin walls, so the engine misses the wall crossing and reports tunneling at step 1. Reducing dt to 0.001 removes the tunneling, confirming large displacement per (sub)step vs wall thickness is the cause.
